content.short: DeFimoon conducts smart contract audits, tests dapps, and provides DeFi protocol consultations.
content.description: DeFimoon delivers high-quality smart contract audits at a fair price, helping teams verify code security without breaking the bank. The service leverages AI-assisted testing to strengthen the review process and identify issues that may be overlooked in manual checks. Their team remains closely engaged throughout the audit journey and is consistently available to provide consultations after the audit is finished, supporting ongoing security improvements and answering follow-up questions.
